verdicts.reason: Both have the same problems. The hierarchy is upside down: the headline 'JOIN OUR CHOIR!' has shrunk to unreadable micro-text, while the subline 'EVERYONE IS WELCOME!' is now the biggest thing on the banner. The white cloud shapes, which framed the text in the original, now float as faint outlines on the white background next to a boxed photo, so the design falls apart into separate pieces with a dead gap in the middle. B has a slightly more even left margin, but otherwise the two are essentially the same.
